headline: Production data bucket protection is being removed to work around a CI failure instead of fixing the root cause
suppressed: Static scanner finding about missing event notifications (CKV2_AWS_62) — this is a pre-existing resource configuration issue unrelated to this pull request's changes, not a finding about what this PR introduces.

findings.evidence_ref: Removal of `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` block from aws_s3_bucket.data in data_stores.tf
findings.explanation: The prevent_destroy guard prevents accidental deletion of this bucket. Removing it means the bucket can now be destroyed by code changes, exposing production data to loss.
